sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • GOOGL’s second collapse became the absolute focus of the session, down -5.9% at $346 as of midday (12:58 ET), with an intraday low of $341.78. The triggers were DeepMind Nobel laureate John Jumper moving to Anthropic, Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer moving to OpenAI, compounded by a $40 billion secondary offering and anxiety over AI infrastructure spending. Both the community and institutions broadly agreed that “dropping 7% over losing one researcher” was an absurd overreaction, and contrarians aggressively bought the dip in shares and calls.
  • Mega-cap tech was sold off collectively (“Bag7”): NFLX -6.5% to $72.35, hitting a 52-week low (loss of content contracts + intensifying competition), AMZN -4.6% to $233, META -2.6% to $562, MSFT -2.7% to $369 (down nearly 20% YTD). Only TSLA bucked the trend, +1.8% to $408, becoming the only green mega cap and repeatedly mocked.
  • Memory/semiconductors went solo, completely decoupling from the broader market: MU +5.2% to $1191 (earnings showdown after the close on Wednesday 6/24), SNDK +5.3% to $2301, INTC +4.5%, SMCI +15.7%, CRDO (optical communications) +8.9%. But divergence within the sector was clear—AVGO -3.4%, MRVL -2.3% (routine selling pressure after S&P inclusion arbitrage), NVDA -0.4%, WDC -2.1%.
  • SPCX broke below its IPO price and continued collapsing, -10.4% to $165.81 (intraday low $165, nearing IPO price), wiping out approximately $700 billion in market cap from its peak and dragging down the entire space sector: RKLB -7.1%, falling below $100; ASTS -7.7% to $74.5; CRWV -8.4%; LUNR -4.7%. The approaching lock-up expiration was repeatedly warned about.
  • Macro turned hawkish: After Warsh’s first FOMC, market pricing for a September rate hike rose to roughly 49%, year-end PCE expectations were raised to 3.6%, the 2-year yield pushed to 4.2%, the 10-year to 4.47%, and the U.S. Dollar Index strengthened. BoA called for “no rate cuts before 2028.”
  • Oil prices fell and the Iran situation eased: JD Vance said Iran agreed to allow UN inspectors to return, and WTI pulled back; however, Trump continued to threaten fresh strikes, keeping the Strait of Hormuz issue volatile.

社区氛围：极其混乱和痛苦的看跌基调——表面上 SPY 仅略有下降，但社区“感觉-90%”。软件和Bag7仓位的持有者到处哀嚎，内存多头独自庆祝，整体情绪充满了“避险信心崩溃，被迫追逐AI镐铲股”的断裂和黑色幽默的绝望。

恐惧/贪婪：结构上的极度恐惧。指数广度分化严重——DIA +0.4%，IWM +0.9%（小盘股连续三周抵抗跌幅），而 QQQ -0.5% 和纳斯达克指数则受到 GOOGL/NFLX/AMZN/MSFT 的拖累。 AAPL +0.8% 和内存股是唯一的“市场支柱”。

情绪与实际交易：评论中的崩盘叙述远远超过了实际指数跌幅。自上午 10:30 起，SPY 一直在 744-747（“条形码”/低成交量）之间窄幅振荡，几次小 V 形反弹吸引多头，然后再次消退，反复用 θ 碾压 0DTE 玩家。社区情绪与软件/大型股的真正大幅抛售相匹配，但与指数整体的“虚假平静”截然不同。
